sentences.text: No; a UCB shall not levy any charges where pre-payment is effected at the instance of the bank.
The current UCB directions on pre-payment charges apply to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
The earlier RBI directions on pre-payment charges are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
